verdict.rationale: Sierra's engineering blog describes building an 'MCP gateway' that connects its AI agents to external tools and systems via MCP, indicating the underlying capability exists, but there is no customer-facing documentation showing how an end user configures or plugs in arbitrary MCP servers. Missing for 10: detailed docs/UI showing customers adding third-party MCP servers, independent corroboration, and clarity on whether this is customer-configurable vs. purely internal infrastructure.
